verses.text: Ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán, winh ajk'o'ol yajoch t'a heb' israel, ix yak' winh rey chi' t'a ix Ester. Haxo winhaj Mardoqueo chi', niwan yopisio winh ix ak'ji yuj winh rey chi', yujto toxo ix yal ix Ester chi' to te ayto yuj sb'a ix yet' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anel k'e'en skolk'ab' winh rey chi', k'e'en ix ik'chajek' t'a winhaj Amán, ix yak'anoch k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi'. Haxo masanil tas ay t'a winhaj Amán ak'b'il t'a ix Ester chi', ix ak'ji'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Mardoqueo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ochxi ix Ester t'a yichanh winh rey chi'. Ix em kuman ix, ix och ijan ix yok'i. Ix tewi ix to tz'ik'ji'el yopisio jun ley te chuk ix sb'o winhaj Amán chi'. Ix yalan ix to max elk'och tas syal jun ley chi' t'a heb' israel.
Ix yak'anelta sk'okoch winh rey chi' nab'a oro t'a ix, ix k'e linhan ix t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin rey, tato wach' hin t'a yol ha sat, tato wach' tas tzin k'an tik tzab'i, tato t'a wal yel xajan hin hu'uj, komonok tzak' tz'ib'chajb'at junokxo ley yik tz'el yopisio tas syal jun ley ix yak'b'at winhaj Amán yuninal winhaj Hamedata yinhtilal winhaj Agag t'a masanil yol ha makb'en b'aj syala' to satji'el masanil heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol techaj wu'uj wilan tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' wetchonhab' yuj tas ol aj ko satji'eli, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Asuero chi' t'a ix yet' t'a winhaj Mardoqueo chi' icha tik: --Ha winhaj Amán chi' lokanxok'e winh t'a te te', yujto chuk tas ix snacha'anh winh t'a spatik heb' heyetchonhab'. Masanil tas ay t'a winh, toxo ix wak' t'ayach.

Ha tikne'ik tz'ib'ejb'at icha tas tze na yuj swach'ilok masanil heb' heyetchonhab' chi'. Tzeyak'anoch hin b'i yet' hin sello t'ay. Yujto ha junok ley b'aj ayoch hin b'i yet' hin sello t'ay, maxtzak yal-laj yek'i, xchi winh.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj heb' winh stz'ib'um winh rey chi', ayik 23 yoch yoxil uj skuch Siván. Masanil tas ix yal winhaj Mardoqueo chi' ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a masanil heb' israel, t'a heb' winh yajal, t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, t'a masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a 127 makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', skotto t'a India masanto sk'och t'a Etiopía. Ix tz'ib'chajb'at t'a sti' yet' t'a sletra junjun chonhab' yet' t'a sti' heb' israel.

Ix ochpax sello winhaj rey Asuero t'ay yik scheklaji to ha winh tz'alani. Ha heb' ix b'at spuk jun ley chi', ha t'a yib'anh nok' chej jelan sb'eyi, haton nok' schej winh rey ayek' t'a yet'tal, hata' ix k'e heb'.

Ha t'a jun ley ix yalb'at winh rey chi', yalnhej tas chonhab'il b'aj ayek' heb' israel chi', syal smolb'an sb'a heb' yik skolan sb'a heb'. Tato ay heb' ajk'o'ol yalnhej tas chonhab'il sk'och t'a heb' yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, syal satanel heb' ajk'o'ol chi' heb'. Yet' pax yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal heb' ajk'o'ol chi' syal satanel heb'. Syik'ankanek' heb' tas ay t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ha juntzanh tik, junnhej k'uhal tz'aj sb'o t'a masanil yol smakb'en winhaj rey Asuero chi', haton t'a jun k'u chekel yajkan t'a 13 yoch slajchawil uj skuch Adar.

Ha scopia'il jun ley chi', yowalil spukax t'a junjun makanhil yaj smakb'en winh rey chi', yowalil tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil chonhab' yujto ley yaji, yik wach' ha t'a jun k'u chi', masanil heb' israel chi' syak' lista sb'a heb' yik spakan sb'a heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.

Ha heb' winh ix b'at yal jun ley chi', elanhchamel ix chekjib'at heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', ix k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' schej winh. Ix alchajpaxel jun ley chi' t'a chonhab' Susa chi', b'ab'el chonhab' yaj t'a yol smakb'en winh rey chi'.

Ayik ix elta winhaj Mardoqueo t'a sdespacho winh rey chi', ayoch spichul winh yik yopisio yuj, k'ik'mutz'inak yet' saksak yilji. Ayk'e jun niwan corona nab'a oro t'a sjolom winh, ayoch jun xotil winh nab'a lino k'ik'mutz'inak yilji. Masanil heb' anima ay t'a chonhab' Susa chi', ix awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Yuj chi' ha heb' israel ix el lenaj ix yil heb', ix te tzalaj heb', yujto ix ik'jicha'anh heb' ix yab'i.

Ayik ix k'och jun ley chi' t'a masanil lugar yet' t'a junjun chonhab', masanil heb' israel ix te tzalaji. Ix yak'anoch jun k'inh heb', ix wa heb'. Tzijtum heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' ix yak'och sb'a israelal yet' heb', yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel chi'.
